notes: Checked against the README of the book's GitHub repository, which calls the PDF there canonical and greenteapress.com a mirror. The README states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the work, copyright Allen B. Downey and Chris Mayfield; NonCommercial, and Ceder has paid plans, so an app only links to it. The book is also sold in print and as an ebook. The repository's LICENSE file, which the README names, returned 404 on the raw host. greenteapress.com and the free HTML edition on GitHub Pages (chrismayfield.github.io) are not reachable from here and were not read.
